glyph_compatibility_finding: Checkpoint 11B's source/direction overlays used text-based symbol layers ('text-field': '■'/'▲'), whose rendering depends on MapLibre's font-glyph pipeline (local PBF glyphs or a remote glyph/sprite URL declared by the active style). The neutral token-free fallback style declares no glyphs URL, so this was classified TOKEN_FREE_TEXT_GLYPH_RENDERING_COMPATIBILITY_NOT_PROVEN and fixed at the source, not worked around.
reason_for_glyph_independent_overlays: Avoids adding a remote glyph/sprite dependency (which would make the token-free mode network-dependent) and avoids a MapLibre major-version upgrade undertaken solely to chase newer font behavior.
source_icon_strategy: A deterministic diamond marker built as a raw RGBA Uint8ClampedArray pixel buffer (presentationIcons.js::buildSourceMarkerImage), registered via map.addImage() -- zero canvas, zero DOM, zero font/glyph/sprite dependency. Rendered via an icon-image symbol layer (mapLibreAdapter.js::sourceIconLayout), never text-field.
direction_icon_strategy: A deterministic north-facing (upright) triangle built the same way (buildDirectionArrowImage), registered via map.addImage(), rendered via icon-image + icon-rotate (directionIconLayout) reading feature.properties.direction.bearing_deg verbatim through a nested MapLibre get expression -- identical to the expression used in Checkpoint 11B, no arithmetic/offset added.
